explainer_content.short_definition: Late-80s and 90s R&B pop with hip-hop drums, swing rhythm, and choreographed polish.
explainer_content.history_capsule: New jack swing arrived when R&B absorbed hip-hop production energy without giving up vocal hooks, dance performance, or pop ambition.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It built the bridge from classic R&B bands and quiet storm into hip-hop soul, 90s R&B groups, and modern pop production.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: The beat snaps harder than smooth R&B, but the song still depends on melody and vocal arrangement.

canonical_example_rationales.why_this_example_matters: Janet Jackson anchors New Jack Swing / 80s-90s R&B Pop by making gospel-shaped vocal force and bass-and-drum groove easier to hear.
Boyz II Men anchors New Jack Swing / 80s-90s R&B Pop by making bass-and-drum groove and horns or strings around the vocal easier to hear.
Control - Janet Jackson anchors New Jack Swing / 80s-90s R&B Pop by making horns or strings around the vocal and syncopated rhythm easier to hear.
Rhythm Nation 1814 - Janet Jackson anchors New Jack Swing / 80s-90s R&B Pop by making syncopated rhythm and dancefloor or late-night mood control easier to hear.
Rhythm Nation - Janet Jackson anchors New Jack Swing / 80s-90s R&B Pop by making dancefloor or late-night mood control and gospel-shaped vocal force easier to hear.
